title: 14:14 I will ascend above the heights of the clouds. Lucifer wanted to dwell in heaven, which is above the clouds, but no soul is able to ascend into heaven without following the proper prescriptions set forth by God, including being baptized, receiving the Holy Ghost, and attaining a godly character. Lucifer, therefore, will never enter heaven. The irony here is that Lucifer received the opposite of his desire— instead of ascending into heaven, he fell, or was "cut down to the ground" (14:12).
author: Tina M. Peterson
